DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾われた袋の届け出ですね。お持ちの物はこちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are reporting a bag you found, correct? Is this what you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。口が少し開いていて、刃のある道具が見えました。いきなり中身を出さず、先にお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った袋に刃物が見え中身を出す前に伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The opening was slightly open, and I saw a tool with a blade. I would like to tell you before suddenly taking anything out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you saw a blade in the bag you found and want to report it before taking out the contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で取り出さず、その状態を伺います。どこで見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not take it out yourself. I will ask about its condition. Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩道の端です。最初から口が開いていました。刃へ触れたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩道で最初から開口し刃には触れていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the edge of the sidewalk. It was already open when I found it. I did not touch the blade.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bag was already open on the sidewalk and that you did not touch the blade. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋は今までどのようにお持ちでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: How have you been carrying the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち手を持って運びました。途中で閉め直したり、道具を別の袋へ移したりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持手で運び閉め直しや移替えはしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I carried it by the handles. I have not closed it again along the way or moved the tool into another bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you carried it by the handles and neither closed it again nor moved the contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が中身と取扱いを確認します。場所や見つけた時刻も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the contents and how to handle them. We will also ask where and when you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 場所はこのメモです。時刻は今朝の出勤前です。用途が分からない道具を仕事道具と決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 場所と出勤前の時刻を示し用途は不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The location is in this note. It was this morning before work. I do not know what the tool is for and have not assumed it is a work tool.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the location and the time before work, and say that its purpose is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その範囲でお伝えください。手などを傷つけてはいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us what you know within those limits. Have you injured your hands or anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: けがはしていません。袋の扱いはお任せし、見つけた状態と運んだ経緯を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 負傷なしと伝え取扱いを任せ発見と運搬経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am not injured. I will leave the handling of the bag to you and explain how I found and carried it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you are uninjured, leave the handling to staff, and explain how you found and transported it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状態を先に知らせてくださりありがとうございます。それでは、担当が確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us about its condition first. The person in charge will now check it. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒は、勤務先で用意されたものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was this envelope provided by your workplace?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。余った封筒をもらいました。料金の表示があるので、家族への手紙も切手なしで送れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社封筒の料金表示で私用手紙も切手不要と思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. They gave me some leftover envelopes. Since it has a postage indication, I thought I could also send a letter to my family without stamps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the postage indication on a company envelope made you think a personal letter needed no stamp. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒をもらったことと、会社の料金の取扱いを使えることは別です。私用の発送について、会社へ確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Receiving an envelope and being allowed to use the company's postage arrangement are separate matters. Have you asked the company about personal mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 封筒を使ってよいとは言われましたが、郵便料金を会社へ請求してよいとは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒使用は了承されたが料金請求の許可は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said I could use the envelope, but I have not asked whether I may charge the postage to the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that using the envelope was approved but permission to charge the postage has not been confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その表示のまま差し出さず、会社の担当と、発送窓口でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not mail it with that indication as it is. Check with the person responsible at your company and at the mailing counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。差出人を会社にして、自分の手紙を仕事の郵便として扱ってもらうつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の手紙を会社の業務郵便として差出さないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I do not intend to put the company as the sender and have my own letter treated as business mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not send your own letter as company business mail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 料金表示の扱いが不明なら、別の封筒で私用の手紙を準備することもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you are unsure how that postage indication is handled, you can also prepare your personal letter in a different envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の封筒に書き直します。会社から受け取った封筒は使わず、料金は自分の発送として確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別封筒へ書直し個人発送として料金を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write the address again on another envelope. I will not use the envelope from the company and will check the postage as my own mailing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will rewrite it on another envelope and check the postage as personal mail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先と差出人、手紙の準備を見直してから、送り方をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking the recipient, sender, and letter preparation, please ask us about how to send it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。個人の名前で書き、料金を自分で払います。会社の表示がある封筒を、料金不要の券とは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個人名で書き自己負担とし会社表示を無料券と考えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will write my personal name and pay the postage myself. I will remember that an envelope bearing the company's indication is not a free-postage voucher.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will use your own name, pay the postage yourself, and not regard the company indication as a free-postage voucher. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができましたらご案内します。それでは、記入台をご利用ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will help you once you are ready. Please use the writing desk. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お金の管理方法についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice on managing money, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達と旅行代を貯めています。二人で出した分を私の口座へ入れれば、二人名義になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の旅行貯金を個人口座へ入れると共同名義になるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend and I are saving for a trip. I thought that putting both our contributions into my account would make it a joint account in both our names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether putting two people's travel savings into a personal account makes it jointly held. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座名義と、二人で出したお金という事情は別です。希望される管理方法を担当へお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The account holder's name and the fact that two people contributed money are separate matters. Please tell the person in charge how you would like to manage it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の口座を二人名義と呼ぶのは違いますね。自分一人の貯金として説明せず、二人で出したと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名義と資金出所を区別して二人が出したと説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Calling my account an account in both our names would be incorrect. I will explain that we both contributed, rather than describing it as savings belonging only to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish the account name from the source of funds and explain that both people contributed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 金額や目的、ご本人同士で決めたことを整理してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please organize and bring the amounts, purpose, and what the two of you have agreed on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が二万円、友達が一万円です。合計三万円ですが、友達の分を自分の残高から忘れてしまわない管理を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己二万円と友人一万円の管理を混同したくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I contributed twenty thousand yen and my friend ten thousand. That is thirty thousand in total, but I want a way to manage it without losing track of my friend's share within my balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you do not want to mix up management of your twenty thousand yen and your friend's ten thousand yen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取扱いの条件を確認してから、利用方法をご検討ください。暗証番号の共有はご案内する方法ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the applicable conditions before considering how to use the account. Sharing a PIN is not a method we recommend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。二人で使いたいからとカードや番号を渡すのではなく、出した額を記録して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カードや番号共有でなく出資額を記録して相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Rather than handing over my card or PIN because we both want to use it, I will record our contributions and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the contributions and seek advice rather than sharing a card or PIN. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本日はまだ入金のお申込みではなく、管理方法の確認でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: So today you are checking how to manage the money, rather than applying to make a deposit, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は相談だけです。銀行の条件を聞いた後、友達ともどう管理するか決め直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日は入金でなく相談のみで友人とも管理を再検討すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Today is only a consultation. After hearing the bank's conditions, I will discuss with my friend again how we should manage it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that today is a consultation rather than a deposit and that you will reconsider the arrangement with your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へおつなぎします。それでは、ご相談の席でお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your request to the person in charge. Please wait at the consultation seating area. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の品のお受け取りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect an item you reserved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。かばんの整理で、この小さい紙を広告だと思って捨てるところでした。予約の控えだったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 広告と思い捨てそうになった予約控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. While sorting my bag, I nearly threw this small slip away because I thought it was an advertisement. It was my reservation slip, wasn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the reservation slip you nearly discarded as an advertisement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記載された注文内容をご確認ください。今日はどの商品をお受け取りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the order details written on it. Which product are you collecting today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パンの詰め合わせ一箱です。自分で食べる分も一緒に買うので、予約品と今日の追加を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約詰合せ一箱と当日追加品を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One box of assorted bread. I am also buying some for myself, so I would like to keep the reserved items separate from today's additions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to separate the reserved box of assorted bread from today's additional purchases. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご予約の箱を確認します。追加のお買い物は、そちらのかごの物ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the reserved box. Your additional purchases are the items in that basket, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうです。控えに書かれている分だけ受け取ってから、かごの商品も会計したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控えの品の受取と追加会計の順を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I would like to receive just the items on the slip first, then pay for the items in the basket as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about collecting the items on the slip first and paying for the additional items afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お支払い済みかどうかも、ご予約の記録で確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check the reservation record to see whether payment has already been made.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。控えを持っているだけで支払い済みとは言いません。予約した時の案内を覚え切れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控え所持だけで支払済とは言わず記録確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I am not saying it is paid just because I have the slip. I do not remember all the instructions I received when I reserved it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not claim that having the slip proves payment; ask staff to check the record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで確認して、受け渡しと会計をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check here and explain the collection and payment procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。確認が終わるまで控えを残します。受取り後も必要か聞いてから、紙を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認まで控えを残し受取後の保管要否も尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will keep the slip until the check is finished. I will ask whether I need it after collection before sorting out the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the slip until confirmation and ask whether it must be kept after collection. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えを提示いただきありがとうございます。それでは、予約の記録を確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for showing your slip. I will now check the reservation record. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の遊び場をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the next play area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 水遊びを終えて、子どもがこのまま滑り台へ行きたがっています。靴も濡れているので、使う場所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水遊び後に濡れた靴で遊具へ移る前に場所の案内を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: We have finished playing in the water, and my child wants to go straight to the slide. Their shoes are wet too, so I would like to check which area we may use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After water play, ask for guidance before moving to playground equipment with wet shoes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 各遊び場の案内をご確認ください。今は水場の外で、足元を整えてから移動なさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the instructions at each play area. For now, move outside the water area and get your footwear in order before moving on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。子どもは私の隣です。濡れたまま走り出す前に、タオルで拭いて着替えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもを隣に置き走る前に拭いて着替えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My child is beside me. Before they run off while still wet, I will dry them with a towel and change their clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep your child beside you, dry them, and change their clothes before they run. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 着替えは、周囲の通行を妨げない場所でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please change clothes somewhere that does not obstruct people passing by.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この通路の真ん中では広げません。ベンチへ移って、自分たちの荷物をまとめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路へ荷物を広げずベンチへ移ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not spread our things out in the middle of this path. I would like to move to a bench and gather our belongings together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will move to a bench without spreading your belongings across the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所の案内を確認しましょう。濡れた物を乾いたベンチへ置くときもご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the area instructions. Please also be considerate when putting wet items on a dry bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋に入れて足元へ置きます。遊具を使えるかは、着替えたから大丈夫と自分だけで決めず、そちらの表示も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 濡れ物を袋に入れ遊具側の表示も確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put them in a bag at my feet. I will not decide by myself that the equipment is fine to use just because we have changed clothes; I will also read the signs there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will bag the wet items and check the signs at the playground equipment as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の場所へ進む前に、忘れ物もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check for belongings you might leave behind before moving to the next area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 靴と濡れた服を分けて片付け、子どもと一緒に案内を見ます。タオルも置き忘れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 靴と服を分け子どもと案内を見てタオルも回収すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pack the shoes and wet clothes separately and read the instructions with my child. I will make sure not to leave the towel behind either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate shoes and clothes, read the instructions with your child, and collect the towel too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、引き続きお子様とお過ごしください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please continue enjoying your time with your child. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 傘のお預けについてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about leaving an umbrella here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行の案内所で借りた傘を返したいです。駅の落とし物窓口へ渡せば返却になると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内所の借傘を駅の遺失物窓口で返せると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to return an umbrella I borrowed from the tourist information office. I came because I thought handing it to the station's lost-property counter would count as returning it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought you could return an umbrella borrowed from an information office at the station's lost-property counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの案内所でお借りになりましたか。貸出しの案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which information office did you borrow it from? Do you have the lending instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の外の案内所です。このカードに返す場所が書かれていました。駅員さんから借りた物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅外の貸出元と返却場所が記されたカードを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The information office outside the station. This card says where to return it. I did not borrow it from a station employee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the card identifying the lender outside the station and the return location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 貸出先の返却案内をご確認ください。落とし物として預けるのとは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the lender's return instructions. This is different from handing in lost property.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。この傘は拾った物とは伝えません。カードにある案内所へ連絡して返せる時間を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 拾得品とせず貸出元へ返却時間を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not say this is an umbrella I found. I will contact the information office on the card and ask what time I can return it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not treat it as found property and will ask the lender about return hours. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 列車のご予定に、お時間の余裕はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have some time before your scheduled train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出発まで少しあります。ただ、急いで勝手に入口へ置くのでなく、受け取ってもらえるか確認して行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発車まで余裕はあるが無断で入口へ置かず受領を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a little time before departure. Still, rather than rushing and leaving it at the entrance without permission, I want to check whether they can receive it before going.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have time before departure but will confirm acceptance instead of leaving it at the entrance without permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返却の取扱いは貸出先へお尋ねください。傘はお客様のお手元でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the lender about return arrangements. Keep the umbrella with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。貸出カードと傘を一緒に持って案内所へ確認します。駅の窓口で返却済みだとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カードと傘を持ち貸出元へ確認し駅で返却済とは言わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will take the lending card and umbrella together and check with the information office. I will not say that I have returned it at the station counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the card and umbrella to check with the lender and will not claim it has been returned at the station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 貸出先の案内をご確認ください。それでは、お忘れ物なくお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the lender's instructions. Have a good journey, and make sure you have all your belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 配布された案内の利用についてのご質問ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about using the information sheet that was distributed, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の掲示にこの案内を使いたいです。必要な一行だけ写したら、対象者の説明が抜けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社掲示へ一行だけ写すと対象説明が抜けたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to use this information on a company noticeboard. When I copied only the one line I needed, I left out the explanation of whom it applies to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that copying only one line for a company notice omitted the description of the intended audience. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの内容を、どなたへ知らせたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What information would you like to share, and with whom?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ごみの出し方です。私の住む地区の紙ですが、職場には別の地区に住む人もいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自地区のごみ案内を他地区の同僚にも見せたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: How to put out rubbish. This sheet is for the district where I live, but some people at my workplace live in other districts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to show your district's rubbish guidance to colleagues in other districts too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地区によって案内が違う場合があります。対象の地区や元の案内を分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The instructions may differ by district. Please make the applicable district and original information clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の地区の曜日を「市内の全員」と書き換えるのはやめます。別の地区の確認先も載せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自地区の曜日を市内全員のルールとせず確認先を載せると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not rewrite my district's collection days as applying to everyone in the city. I would also like to include where people in other districts can check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not present your district's collection days as a citywide rule and will include a contact for confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最新版の確認先や掲示の利用について、担当へお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can ask the person in charge where to check the latest information and about using it on a noticeboard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。この紙は去年受け取ったものなので、今の案内かも確認してから掲示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 去年の文書なので最新版と利用方法を担当へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help me with that. I received this sheet last year, so I will check whether it is current before posting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Since the document is from last year, check with the person in charge about the latest version and how it may be used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の案内の名称と、配布された時期をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring the title of the original information and when it was distributed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名称と去年の紙だということを伝えます。短くまとめても、地区と更新時点が消えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名称と時期を示し対象地区と更新時点を省かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give the title and explain that the sheet is from last year. Even if I shorten it, I will keep the district and the date of the update clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the title and date, and say that you will not omit the applicable district or update date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当の確認先をご案内します。それでは、掲示前にご相談ください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will show you how to contact the person in charge. Please consult them before posting it. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の記録は、こちらの二冊でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are these two booklets your medication records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。新しい一冊だけ渡そうと思いましたが、古い方にも記録があります。両方見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新旧二冊とも記録があり両方見てほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was going to hand over only the newer one, but the older one has records too. I would like you to look at both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that both the old and new booklets contain records and that you want both checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ頃、それぞれの手帳をお使いでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Around when did you use each booklet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い方は去年まで、新しい方は今年からです。でも、去年の記録の薬を全部今も飲んでいるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 去年までと今年からの手帳で旧薬全てが現服用ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The old one until last year and the new one from this year. However, I am not still taking all the medicines recorded last year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the booklets cover up to last year and from this year, and that not all older medicines are currently taken. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録の日付と、現在の服用状況を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the person in charge the dates of the records and what you are currently taking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。古いページを破って今の薬だけにするのでなく、そのまま見せて、今の状態を話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古いページを破らず記録と現在の状況を分けて話すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Rather than tearing out the old pages to leave only my current medicines, I will show them as they are and explain my current situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not tear out old pages and will distinguish the records from your current situation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在使っている薬の情報も、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also have information about the medicines you are currently using?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薬の袋もあります。手帳の日付だけで今も使っていると決めず、袋と自分の服用状況を確認して伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬袋も提示し日付だけで現服用とせず状況を確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the medicine bags too. I will not assume that a medicine is still in use just from the booklet date; I will check the bags and what I am taking and explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the medicine bags too, and say that you will check the situation rather than infer current use from dates alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どの記録が現在のものか分からない場合は、そのことも担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you do not know which records are current, please tell the person in charge that as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。覚えていない分を飲んでいないと決めて埋めません。二冊と袋を出し、分かる事実から説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明分を未服用と決めず二冊と袋で分かる事実から説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not fill in what I cannot remember by assuming I am not taking it. I will show both booklets and the bags and start with the facts I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not assume unknown medicines are not taken, and will explain known facts using both booklets and the bags. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二冊の使用時期も担当へ伝えます。それでは、記録をお持ちのままご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will also tell the person in charge when you used each booklet. Please keep the records with you and wait for further instructions. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前のご相談に関するご連絡でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you contacting us about an earlier consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の相談と一緒にしたい話があります。昨日、新しいメッセージが来ましたが、前と同じ人からかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の新連絡が以前の相談相手と同じか不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is something I would like to discuss together with my earlier consultation. A new message arrived yesterday, but I do not know whether it is from the same person as before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know whether yesterday's new contact came from the person involved in the earlier consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の相談の控えと、今回の連絡をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the record of the previous consultation and this new message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。控えはこちらです。今回の連絡先は表示が違うので、同じ相談の相手だと決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧控えと異なる連絡先表示を示し同一と断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Here is the record. The contact details displayed this time are different, so I have not decided that it is the person from the same consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the old record and different contact display, and say that you are not assuming they are the same person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の連絡が届いた日時と、内容を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask separately about when this message arrived and what it says.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夜です。前の文章に似ていますが、似ているということと同一人物という判断を分けて話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日夜の類似文章と送信者の同一性を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was last night. The wording resembles the earlier message, but I will distinguish that resemblance from a judgment that it is the same person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the similar wording received last night separately from whether the sender is the same person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が両方の情報を確認します。元のメッセージは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check both sets of information. Do you still have the original messages?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残っています。一つの画像へ切り貼りせず、昨日の連絡と前の記録を別々に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切貼りせず新旧の元メッセージを別々に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will show yesterday's message and the earlier records separately, without cutting and pasting them into one image.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the original old and new messages separately without combining them into one image. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、ご自身で返答したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you replied yourself in any other way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨日の連絡には返信していません。前の相談時に伝えた返答と、今回の未返信を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回未返信と以前の返答を区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not replied to yesterday's message. I will distinguish the reply I reported during the earlier consultation from not replying this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the earlier reply from the fact that you have not replied this time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい連絡として担当へ伝えます。それでは、詳しい確認をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will report it to the person in charge as a new contact. Please wait for a detailed check. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: はがきの書き方についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice on filling out a reply-paid postcard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 往復はがきの返信の側に、相手への本文を書いてしまいました。半分を切って普通のはがきにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復はがきの返信側に本文を書き半分に切れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the text for the recipient on the reply half of a reply-paid postcard. Can I cut it in half and use it as an ordinary postcard?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you wrote the message on the reply half of a reply-paid postcard and ask whether you can cut it in half. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切らずに、どこへ何を書いたか見せてください。取扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me where you wrote what, without cutting it. We will check how it can be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ切っていません。相手に戻してもらう側なのに、私から送る文章をそこへ書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未切断で返送側へ自分の送信文を書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not cut it yet. I wrote my outgoing message on the half that the recipient is supposed to send back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is uncut and that you wrote your outgoing message on the return half. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返信と送信の役割を分けて、準備を見直しましょう。もう投函されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's review the preparation by distinguishing the outgoing and reply functions. Have you posted it already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 未投函です。返信側が空いていればよいと思って、表裏の役割を読んでいませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未投函で表裏の役割を読まなかったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not posted it. I thought it was fine as long as the reply side had space, and I did not read what the front and back were for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it has not been posted and that you did not read the functions of the front and back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き損じた物の取扱いや、新しく準備する方法を担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain how to handle the incorrectly filled postcard and how to prepare a new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で切ったら扱いが変わるかもしれないので、このまま持って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切らず現状のまま書損じの取扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Cutting it myself might change how it is treated, so I will keep it as it is and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep it uncut as it is and ask how the incorrectly filled postcard should be handled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新たに書く場合は、送る面と返す面を先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you write a new one, check the outgoing and return sides first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。相手へ送る本文と、自分へ戻る宛名を分けて下書きします。今の物を使えると決めつけず、案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送信本文と返送宛名を下書きで分け利用可否を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will draft the message to the recipient separately from the return address to me. I will hear the instructions without assuming I can use this postcard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate the outgoing message and return address in your draft and check whether this postcard can be used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未投函のまま確認いただきありがとうございます。それでは、担当へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking before posting it. I will now take you to the person in charge. Excuse me.
